metadata.capture_timestamp: Not provided; active asks are a screenshot snapshot, not live inventory.
metadata.source: Six user-supplied Auction House screenshots, manually visually transcribed.
metadata.classification: Yellow rows with Market Price selected are historical sales; white rows with time remaining are active asks.
metadata.scope: All 54 visible rows: 36 historical sale rows (39 stones) and 18 active asking-price rows (71 stones).
metadata.order: Unit Price ascending in all six screenshots.
limitations: Historical pages 1, 2, 6, and 11 of 12 are selected price-sorted slices, not a random or complete market sample.
Active pages 1 and 2 of 5 show only the cheapest visible listings; remaining pages are absent.
Descriptive historical means and medians characterize only transcribed rows, not the full market.
Do not infer a full-market time trend, volatility, confidence interval, causal update effect, or future prices from these selected pages.
Historical trades are not prices at which stones can necessarily be bought now; active asking prices are not evidence of executed trades.
Current World Only is visibly unchecked where the checkbox is shown; market/world scope is unconfirmed.
The unit supply ladder assumes all listed stones remain available and partial-stack purchases are possible at the displayed unit price.
A separate whole-lot ladder supplies acquisition-cost bounds if listings must be bought in full; it does not credit leftover resale value.
Duplicate unit prices are separate visible rows, including page 1/page 2 active rows with different time-left values; they have not been deduplicated.
